svg.title: Work and observation delivery: four reading notes
svg.desc: Numbered notes distinguish task states, waiting time, pending observations and revoked access. The original browser screenshot is embedded unchanged.
svg.text: Where is the work, and what is waiting?
Running is not a health check.
a task that has waited a long time.
These events wait to be sent.
Fixture records from a real gateway API. No live model calls. No claim about worker health.
